Coram : DALVEER BHANDARI*, T.S. THAKUR, DIPAK MISRA
U.P. Sugarcane (Regulation of Supply and Purchase) C Act, 1953 - s. 16 - Fixation of State Advised Price (SAP) for sugarcane, over and above the minimum price fixed by the Central Government - Power of the State Government - Conflicting judgments by the Constitution of the Court - Instant matter before a Bench of three o judges - Since conflicting judgments have been delivered by the Bench of five judges, matter referred to a larger Bench of at least seven judges - However, certain directions issued to the sugar factories to pay the balance outstanding
Decision Date : 17-01-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7508/2005 | Disposal Nature : Matter referred to larger bench | Bench : 3 Judges
